reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Storage version of `imageupdateautomations.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io` changes v1beta2 → v1", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: Existing ImageUpdateAutomation objects stay stored as v1beta2 until rewritten; a storage version migration must be run and status.storedVersions updated before a later release removes v1beta2.
consequence.remediation: Re-write all ImageUpdateAutomation objects and update status.storedVersions on the CRD.

proposed.statement: The ImageUpdateAutomation CRD storage version changes from v1beta2 to v1, so existing objects stay stored as v1beta2 until a storage version migration is run and status.storedVersions is updated before a later release removes v1beta2.
